''See also: [[Navigator Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Navigators are members of a specialized [[Guild]] essential for any maritime commerce or travel within the [[Aion Sea]]. They operate unique, one-of-a-kind vessels known as [[Vessels]], which are [[Awakened objects]]. These ships are constructed by integrating parts of an Elder or a [[Kameira]] into the structure, a complex process that allows the ship to become a functional [[Vessel]]. A central theory and likely reality of their craft is that Navigators are [[Soulbound]] to their ships, granting them an uncanny ability to control the vessel as if it were a part of their own bodies. Because of this mastery, [[Navigator ships]] are highly sought after for passage to various coastal cities or remote islands, and securing space on a vessel not currently burdened by [[Imperial]] debt is considered extremely valuable. While many [[Navigator ships]] are small and operated by a [[Soulbound]] captain alongside a minimal crew, the [[Guild]] maintains a significant presence. Their headquarters in the Capital is a massive structure built from ancient shipwreck remains, featuring portholes and masts. [[The Guild]] is known for protecting its secrets more fiercely than other groups, such as the [[Champions]]. Notable individuals associated with the profession include [[Cheska Bennett]], who leads the Navigators, and [[Calder Marten]]. The fleet is capable of significant movement, though individual ships may vary greatly in appearance, ranging from standard wooden constructions to organic forms resembling giant conch shells.}}

== Of Shadow and Sea ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|Navigators are known to possess their own ships and guard their secrets with even greater intensity than the [[Champions]]. During a journey alongside [[Naberius Clayborn{{!}}Naberius]] and [[Tristania]], one such Navigator accompanied the group. While these individuals frequently undertake officially sanctioned missions, a Navigator eventually approached the party while wearing both an [[Awakened sword]] and the Emperor's crown.}}
